tags.description: Rough pebble/cobble beaches, reefs, kelp, in sheltered cove. Semi-developed camp in forest or small rough beach sites. Beach on NW side might also work. Not used often. Windthrown trees might block sites or create hazards for camping. Views, wildlife.
tags.name: Broken Islands Havannah Channel (BCMT)
